rawFindings.title: Unprocessed binary files are converted to UTF-8 text
rawFindings.explanation: This path now runs for every file, including files with no configured preprocessors. Passing `buffer.toString()` into `nextPreprocessor` causes the final preprocessor step to set `file.content` to a decoded string and `file.contentPath` to `null`, so raw binary assets are no longer preserved byte-for-byte; different invalid UTF-8 byte sequences can also hash to the same replacement-character string.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep track of whether any real preprocessors matched; when none did, compute `file.sha` from the raw Buffer and leave `file.contentPath`/`file.content` unchanged. Only convert to string when running textual preprocessors.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With no preprocessors configured, processing a served file whose bytes are `[0x80]` sets `file.content` to `'�'`; if the file changes to `[0x81]`, the decoded content and SHA remain the same even though the file bytes changed.

rawFindings.title: Read errors now crash preprocessing for files without preprocessors
rawFindings.explanation: Because every file is now read, `fs.readFile` failures for files that previously skipped preprocessing reach `buffer.toString()` with `buffer === undefined`, throwing asynchronously instead of completing or reporting the missing file cleanly.
rawFindings.suggestion: Check `err` in the `fs.readFile` callback before using `buffer`, and propagate/log the failure without calling `buffer.toString()` on an undefined value.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With no preprocessors configured, if `file.originalPath` points to a file deleted between file-list creation and preprocessing, `fs.readFile` returns `ENOENT` and the process throws at `buffer.toString()`.
